decisions.what: Part (i): skip the OAuth occupancy override when an existing eligible pin was reused (a selectedBySessionAffinity flag at auth.ts:1984-1987 and '&& !selectedBySessionAffinity' at :2159; guard form from OmniRoute PR #13102 head baaaaf31). Part (ii): bind a fresh pin to the connection actually served (CLIProxyAPI selector.go:1066-1077; sub2api openai_account_scheduler.go:1237-1238, ordinary selection, which binds the acquired account unless a sticky escape set PreserveStickyBinding; 1327-1330 is the weighted-sticky fallback). As written, a flag set in the if (affinityConnection) block at auth.ts:1984-1987 cannot tell a reused pin from a fresh one, because selectSessionAffinityConnection returns a connection for both (sessionAffinityPin.ts:280-319). The implementation must distinguish them explicitly (GPT-6 record review, P1:action); the patch workflow owns it.
